Machine Learning Engineer

Join our applied AI team. Founded in 2009, we have been building search products for 15 years.

Responsibilities
- Train and deploy ranking models
- Build feature pipelines in Spark

Requirements
- 3-5 years of experience in ML engineering
- Python and PyTorch; ideally also TensorFlow
- Docker. Kubernetes is a plus.
- Required: SQL. Preferred: Airflow.

Benefits
- Yearly bonus and 25 days of holiday
